messages.author: fc99c4780ff0b15e
messages.subject: half diallel MAGIC population
parts:
Dear Dr Karl,

I have a MAGIC population built from eight parents with the following cross design.
G1: complete half diallel to obtain 28 one way hybrids
G2 : incomplete half diallel (without redundancy and consanguinity)(ABxCD but not ABxAH)
G3 : Crosses of the complementary hybrids to obtain 8-way hybrids. (ABCDxEFGH)
The selfing step was made by doing doubled haploid.

I would like to know if it is possible to do parental inference with R/qtl with that kind of cross design?

Sincerely,

Rocher Florian
Biogemma, GGC
Engineer-Intern
florian...@biogemma.com

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] half diallel MAGIC population
parts:
At present, R/qtl can’t handle this cross type.

You could try using R/qtl2 (http://kbroman.org/qtl2) with cross type “riself8”; it’s not quite right but might be sufficient. Ideally, we’d write code specific to the exact cross design you used.

Karl
